race.title: AIS Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: GLANCING JACK 's Newbury handicap debut second in March is strong form and he can make a successful reappearance for new trainer Dan Skelton. High Fibre 's excellent start for the James Owen yard includes a Summer Hurdle win at Market Rasen and a fourth in the Cesarewitch at Newmarket last month so he's an obvious threat. Keno Black has a similar profile to his yard's 2024 winner of this and is next on the list ahead of Norman Fletcher and unexposed Paul Nicholls handicap newcomer Outmaster . GLANCING JACK HIGH FIBRE (IRE) KENO BLACK (FR)
